brief:
Swiss filmmaker Nicolas Wadimoff explores displacement and loss through a documentary that asks Gaza refugees to draw floor plans of their former neighbourhoods, The Guardian reported. The project surfaces raw emotional pain as participants confront the physical spaces they can no longer inhabit.

Wadimoff, a musician and filmmaker with an established focus on Gaza, frames the exercise as a means of confronting grief tied to place and community. The documentary, titled "Who Is Still Alive," examines how people process the loss of homes and neighbourhoods rendered inaccessible by the conflict.
dek: Nicolas Wadimoff invites refugees to draw a floor plan of their former neighbourhood, bringing raw and agonising pain to the surface A sombre documentary from the Swiss musician and film-maker Nicolas Wadimoff, who returns to his longstanding interest in Gaza.
title: Wadimoff documentary maps grief through refugees' lost Gaza homes
